The problem is real, but usage isn’t just about awareness. Most people know sun shades exist, they just don’t use them consistently because of small frictions. Putting it up and taking it down every time feels annoying, storing it is messy, and a lot of cheap ones don’t fit well or look bad. There’s also a habit issue. People think they’ll only park for a few minutes, then it turns into hours. So the opportunity isn’t just selling a sun shade, it’s removing those frictions. Easier to install in seconds, compact when stored, good fit for different cars, and something that doesn’t feel cheap. If you solve convenience and usability, not just the heat problem, it becomes a much stronger product.
